_meta.what: Capturable sites: a boss whose kill hands the place to a clan, read by server/holdings.py (its docstring has the rules). One row a site; a city added later is a row here.
_meta.min_level: RECOVERED. The map labels' «Захват возможен игроками 8 уровня при поддержке клана» (12 for the south warehouse; res/database/locations.xml 315-317): the level two living members of the clan who hurt the boss must have at the kill, and the level of the box's row (data/quests.json 765-767). Донгола's: 12, 16 and 16 (L323-L325; the boxes 768-770).
_meta.squad: DESIGNED, the plan's default 16: «отряд из 2+ членов клана убивает «Хозяина» в окне; уровень — по подписи».
_meta.box_hours: Kept in data/schedule.json, window wh_box: the labels' «Дележ добычи с 19:00 до 20:00».
_meta.box_tenure_hours: DESIGNED: a member takes the box's row only after this many hours in the clan, so that nobody is invited at 19:00 to collect and put out at 19:59.
_meta.box_one_per_account: DESIGNED: one character of an account collects a site's row a day.
_meta.holding: DESIGNED, the owner's decision of 2026-10-09: a clan holds a warehouse until another clan takes it; the clan spec (clans_spec.md:783) had «до следующего окна».
_meta.raid: DESIGNED: the boxes' «Проникнуть на северный/восточный/южный склад Вади Хальфы», quests 789-791 (texts.xml ids 26390-26395), 200000 afro once a day, are left out: who could take them is unknown.
_meta.left_out: DESIGNED: 982 and 983, copies of 109 and 110 with the same bosses, have no map cell and capture nothing; Абу-Хамед's 128, 984 and 1380 wait for their stages (their flags mend for anybody, as before); Абу-Хамед's 288 under «Ангар в джунглях», across the river, is out of the game (data/retired.json, the owner's cut of everything across the river, 2026-10-13). Донгола's three, 113, 114 and 112, are taken with the city (the owner's «и потом сделай донголу тоже», 2026-10-13; the plan's decision 25): the labels L323-L325 «Захват возможен игроками 12/16/16 уровня при поддержке клана», the boxes 768-770.
